run_gpt2_perplexity_eval: run a GPT-2 perplexity evaluation on wikitext data using evaluate_gpt2.py with fp16 and BPE tokenizer
run_gpt2_lambada_cloze_eval: run a Lambada cloze evaluation on a GPT-2 model with optional strict mode for harder formulation
run_gpt2_webtext_eval: run a webtext perplexity evaluation on a GPT-2 model using pretrain_gpt2.py with configurable eval iterations
run_gpt2_multinode_eval: run a GPT-2 evaluation with model parallelism across multiple GPUs using torch distributed launch
run_gpt2_openai_checkpoint_eval: run a GPT-2 evaluation loading weights from saved OpenAI or HuggingFace checkpoints
